speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
text: asked the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs whether the Ministry can provide an update on the police efforts to patrol and effectively eradicate the bullying and assault incidents outside the temples along Waterloo Mall where illegal hawking is rife.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: I first want to thank all the agencies' officers on the ground, from the Police from SLA, from the National Environment Agency (NEA), from MSF, and even the grassroots who look after the ground there.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: Because indeed the area that is along the Waterloo Mall, where lots of temples are, is a very popular place for peddling, legal or not legal, and also for begging as well.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: But because of the bullying and assault episodes, they often involve the vulnerable, both bullies and the bullied.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: SPF tends to adopt a light touch, I guess for worry of public criticisms.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: I just want to know what can the Ministry do more of to support these officers so that we can protect the interests of especially those who are bullied, and also seek the understanding of the public, even if the bullies are themselves vulnerable or disabled.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: So, I wonder if more support and understanding for things that can be done to seek more support from the public so that the police officers can do their job even more effectively.

speaker: Ms Sim Ann
text: This includes the MSF and also the other agencies that I have mentioned.
